cohort_policy: Exactly all64 IDs0..31/task for expanded analysis; alternatively exactly all8 IDs0..3/task explicitly instrumentation-only. No partial subset summaries.

cem.entropy: actual diagonal Gaussian before clipping and mean-candidate insertion; differential entropy may be negative

replay.reconstruction: 1 minus squared error to the centered full-minus-native score-change vector divided by its squared energy; undefined if denominator zero, never clipped
replay.additive_components: also compare sum of common-only and centered-only score-change vectors with full score change; cost functional diagnostic, not output nonadditivity

resampling_unit: scenario, separately within task; never heads, horizons, candidates or CEM iterations
interval: marginal paired-scenario percentile95, descriptive, no corrected discovery claim
controls: all layer/head/horizon cells and both original learned/random arms retained; no favorable site selection
scope: historical development inputs; no fitting-disjointness assumption, no fresh physical outcomes, no physical-coordinate or causal-head claim
provenance: verify execution/input manifest bindings, complete cohort, report/DONE/compact hashes and GCS readback receipts; saved H6 parity is execution-attested when bulk tensors stay in cloud
